_comment: Which source font renders which .ffu. Sizes are auto-fitted to each template's uppercase height. cell = glyph cell height, forced to the template's: the engine scales a glyph by 88/cell, so letting the cell grow to fit Vietnamese tone marks shrinks all text - the 108-cell build rendered 19% smaller than the stock game. Paths are relative to the repo root. glow blurs the coverage before it is quantised to 4bpp, reproducing the soft edge ramp the stock glyphs have; without it the edges stair-step and the text reads rough.

window/font/sysfont.ffu.note: menus and key prompts; px 29 = co lon nhat ma moi ky tu Viet con lot o 37

window/font/advfont1.ffu.note: in-game font option I; px 70 = co lon nhat ma moi ky tu Viet con lot o 88
